messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Subject: Deployment mode discussion & pricing follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Sanjay / Claire,

Thanks again for the call today — great context on the patient-facing triage flow and volume profile. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Peak latency target: <200ms p95 for single-turn generation
- Expected steady-state: ~20M tokens/month; peak bursts around 10 qps (short requests)
- Data sensitivity: PHI in PII-lite form (will need BAA + private VPC or hosted with strict logging controls)
- Uptime / SLA: looking for 99.9%+ for production endpoints

Deployment options we covered (high-level):
1) Hosted API: fastest to production, usage-based per-token pricing, Redwood handles infra and updates. Good if you want low ops and variable volume.
2) Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools (monthly commit) with predictable throughput and lower per-token economics for sustained high volume. Allows private networking and more isolation.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): For regulated data where you need full control — licensing + deployment fee + optional on-prem install.

What we need from your side to finalize a cost model:
- Monthly token estimate (you provided ~20M as a starting point — please confirm)
- Typical request length and typical completion token count (avg user message + model reply)
- Any regulatory constraints (BAA required? SOC 2 already in play?)
- Preferred region (us-east / us-west / eu-central)

I'm attaching a starter pricing model (redwood-deployment-pricing-model.xlsx) with three scenarios so you can see Hosted per-token vs Dedicated commit math vs Private licensing. Also attached a one-page mutual action plan (RDW-Acme-Mutual-Action-Plan.pdf) to capture timeline and responsibilities.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the usage numbers above (tokens/month, avg tokens per request) — Sanjay, can you confirm by EOW?
- If you want, Neha can run a short cost-sensitivity model and recommend a target commit size for Dedicated.
- We can schedule a follow-up next week to go over the spreadsheet and pick an initial path.

Thanks — happy to adjust the model once you confirm the numbers.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion & pricing follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Tokens: 20M/month is our baseline for Q2 pilot. If pilot goes well, we expect to scale to ~75–100M/month in 6–9 months.
- Avg request size: user prompt ~40 tokens, model reply ~120 tokens (so ~160 tokens per exchange)
- Peak QPS: during business hours we could see sustained 6–8 qps and spikes to ~12 qps for short periods.
- Compliance: We do need a BAA and are SOC 2-conscious. We prefer a private VPC for PHI, but open to hosted if BAAs and customer-managed KMS are available.

One more ask — can you include a quick comparison showing 12-month cost on Hosted (per-token) vs Dedicated with 12-month commit at three sizes (small/medium/large)? Prefer to see annualized cost and expected breakeven points.

Claire will get you a short doc with our expected traffic growth curve by Monday.

—Sanjay
Director of AI Platforms | Acme Health

Attached is an updated starter sheet that includes a 12-month annualized comparison for three committed tiers for Dedicated (Small: 4k GPU-hours/month, Medium: 12k GPU-hours/month, Large: 24k GPU-hours/month) alongside Hosted per-token projections. Key takeaways from the preliminary numbers (see redwood-deployment-pricing-model.xlsx):

- Hosted (per-token): at 20M tokens/month the annual cost is approx $X (see sheet). Good for pilots and variable traffic; no commit.
- Dedicated (12-month commit): Medium tier shows ~25–35% cost savings vs Hosted once you sustain >50M tokens/month given our batching/KV-cache efficiencies.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): larger upfront license and deployment fees (one-time) plus lower ongoing unit costs; recommended when you require on-prem or strict data residency/BAA.

I've also added a column showing expected throughput (qps) per tier and a suggested initial commit based on your forecasted growth (we recommend starting at Medium if you think you'll reach 75M tokens in 6–9 months).

Next steps:
- Neha: can you validate the throughput numbers and whether Medium commit supports sustained 12 qps with target latency?
- Sanjay / Claire: Claire, once you share the growth curve, we'll pin the commit size and produce a final 12-month offer (including any promotional credits).

Happy to run a short model during a call — want to propose Tue 31 Mar 10:00am PT?

Hi all,

Validated the throughput numbers and updated the sheet with more granular assumptions (see attached). Summary: 

- Throughput: Medium Dedicated (12k GPU-hours/month) comfortably supports sustained 12 qps for short requests with p95 latency ~180–200ms when using Batching+KV caching for conversational flows. Large tier gives more headroom for future spikes.
- Hosted assumptions: we used per-token inference cost of $0.00025/token for completions plus small per-request overhead; this is reflected in the Hosted column.
- Dedicated economics: after accounting for GPU utilization, batching gains, and infra overhead, Medium 12-month commit equates to ~ $0.00018/token effective at 75M tokens/month (annualized). Breakeven vs Hosted is ~50–55M tokens/month.
- Private: one-time deployment & integration estimate: $85k–120k depending on on-prem vs VPC configuration, plus annual license starting ~$X/month (see sheet).

Suggested commercial language for the offer: 
- Pilot (0–3 months): Hosted with 10% promotional credits; BAA + customer managed KMS enabled.
- If they commit to a 12-month Medium Dedicated within 60 days of pilot start: 2 months credit applied, and we lock unit economics in the offer.

Next steps (operational):
- Aditya/Marissa: prepare a draft Commercial Term Sheet and present to Acme on Tue 31 Mar call.
- Marissa: I'll join the call to defend throughput and the latency guarantees.

Sanjay / Claire: I'll be on the Tue 31 Mar 10:00am PT call (confirmed) to walk through the numbers. Please share the growth curve Claire mentioned so I can finalize the commit recommendation.

Thanks,
